title: 377. First Bad Version

examples.explanation: Versions 4 and 5 are bad; 4 is first.

hints: Adaptation: the hidden API isBadVersion(v) is simulated as v >= bad; both n and bad are given.
Binary-search [1, n] for the first v with v >= bad.
Use mid = left + (right - left) / 2 to avoid overflow.
